How Nativo Reduces QPS by 45% while Cutting Costs by 20% with Assertive Yield

AY Products

Traffic Shaping

Nativo, one of the most advanced platforms for premium ad experiences, built to help advertisers connect and publishers grow, announced that its programmatic business grew by an impressive 120% year-over-year in the second quarter of 2025. 

This recent wave of growth has been driven by the company's massive increase in scale due to rapid adoption by large premium publishers, who are attracted to Nativo's exclusive demand and wide support for unique as well as standard native, display, and video formats.

With the company experiencing unprecedented growth, Nativo needed to optimize its exchange operations while maintaining the high performance standards its partners expect. That is where Assertive Yield Traffic Shaping stepped in.

The Challenges: Managing Rapid Growth While Controlling Infrastructure Costs

As Nativo experienced rapid growth, several operational considerations emerged that required strategic attention:

Optimizing Infrastructure Costs

Nativo needed solutions that would support its rapid supply growth, without requiring significant internal resource investment.

"As we scale our supply literally 10 times this year, controlling serving costs has become a major challenge for us," explains Jinhwa Chun Rustand, Director of Product at Nativo Exchange. The existing infrastructure costs were growing alongside the increased volume.

Advanced Technology Requirements

While Nativo had developed an in-house traffic shaping solution, it needed some of the advanced capabilities required for its evolving business requirements:

  • Flexibility for demand partner-specific optimizations
  • Ability to optimize for different partner benchmarks
  • Real-time adjustment capabilities
  • Minimal engineering involvement for modifications

The Solutions: Driving Scalable Growth and Enhanced Efficiency with Advanced Traffic Shaping

After consistently hearing strong industry feedback about Assertive Yield, Nativo evaluated the Traffic Shaping solution against its requirements and competitive alternatives."

Build Vs. Buy? A Strategic Decision

When weighing whether to keep building in-house or partner externally, Nativo prioritized stability, speed, and efficiency. Many alternatives posed risks to exchange stability, an absolute non-negotiable for a platform scaling tenfold in supply. 

Assertive Yield stood out not only for its resilient design, which ensures minimal disruptions even during unexpected issues, but also for its ability to deliver impact quickly without a heavy engineering lift.

"Other solutions posed a potential threat to our exchange stability, which was a major issue. Whereas Assertive Yield's design ensures minimal disruptions to our exchange workflow, even if there is some kind of issue that comes up." Jinhwa Chun Rustand, Director of Product at Nativo

Smarter Traffic Shaping 

Controlling traffic volume in sync with demand growth is crucial for a rapidly scaling exchange. Assertive Yield enables Nativo to dynamically adjust traffic shaping volume in near real time, without the need for backend interventions. This agility allowed Nativo to manage both rising bid request volume and serving costs effectively, ensuring that performance kept pace with scale.

Granular Optimization Controls

According to Nativo, previously, adapting to partners’ specific needs required heavy engineering effort. With Assertive Yield, Nativo’s product team gained granular, partner-level controls that could be applied instantly and flexibly, without depending on engineering cycles. This reduced operational overhead while strengthening demand partner relationships.

"Assertive Yield has enabled us to respond quickly to demand partners' goals and benchmarks, something that previously required much heavier engineering involvement. The ability to dynamically optimize these requirements has been very transformative to us."

Optimized vs. Non-optimized Traffic Comparison

Using historical data, to have a comparison of the Traffic Shaping optimized traffic vs the non-optimized one, Nativo records roughly 5% of its traffic still runs through its legacy traffic shaping, and based on performance, the results are comparable to AY in terms of baseline optimization. 

However, according to the fast-rising company, the reason they rely more heavily on AY is not just performance parity; it’s the flexibility and control it provides.

While its in-house solution could only optimize for a single objective: best aggregate traffic shaping results. In contrast, AY allows them to account for the nuances of different demand partners. Like:

  • Demand partners requiring a strict benchmark RPM
  • Demand partners requiring strict Query Per Second caps
  • Demand partners highly favoring matched traffic

“This flexibility has proven far more valuable in practice, enabling us to maximize yield across a diverse set of partners while still maintaining strong optimization outcomes.” Nativo

Seamless Onboarding and Support 

Implementation exceeded expectations. Within just 2–3 weeks, Nativo’s engineering team was fully onboarded, one of the fastest timelines achieved to date. What made the difference was accurate, up-to-date documentation and hands-on support from the AY team that simplified every step. 

Results: Higher Revenue, Lower Costs, and Demand Partners' Satisfaction

The partnership with Assertive Yield delivered significant improvements across multiple business metrics:

Reduced Costs, Increased Net Revenue

With Assertive Yield, Nativo lowered serving costs by 20% without impacting margins. As Jinhwa explains: 

"With Assertive Yield alone, we lowered our serving costs by 20%, which directly translated into a 20% net revenue uplift. What it means is that if serving used to cost us like a dollar CPM, AY helped reduce it to $0.30, and our revenue stayed the same."

This demonstrates how AY’s optimizations go beyond financial lift, as it enabled Nativo to sustain performance while driving efficiency.

Achieved 45% QPS Reduction While Maintaining Revenue Performance

By shaping around 45% of all bid requests, Nativo lowered unnecessary traffic without compromising revenue. This efficiency not only reduced infrastructure strain but also proved that optimization can coexist with sustained marketplace performance.

Boost Agility and Stronger Partner Relationships

Assertive Yield empowered Nativo to adapt instantly to evolving partner requirements, whether it’s adhering to strict bid requests optimizations, RPMs benchmark, or prioritizing matched traffic. This real-time flexibility not only ensured consistent optimization across diverse demand partners but also strengthened relationships by aligning with each partner’s unique needs.

Sustained Revenue Growth with Scaling Supply

AY Traffic Shaping played a central role in powering Nativo’s broader growth. As supply increased, the company handled a 635% YoY increase in bid requests while scaling revenue efficiently. This momentum translated into a 246% increase in open indirect revenue and 150% YoY growth in Q2 programmatic revenue.

Beyond the numbers, Nativo’s ability to maintain stability at scale was a key factor in sustaining revenue momentum and being recognized as a fast-rising player in the exchange ecosystem.

Conclusion

The partnership has positioned Nativo for continued growth and market leadership. As Jinhwa reflects: "If I were to recommend Assertive Yield to my peers, I would highlight how it gives us both the speed and the control that allows us to scale efficiently while reducing the risk and resource constraints."

For SSPs and product leaders managing similar growth trajectories, Nativo's experience demonstrates how strategic technology partnerships can deliver substantial operational improvements while maintaining partner relationships and exchange stability.

By pairing their unique exchange vision with Assertive Yield’s Traffic Shaping, Nativo unlocked a new level of efficiency, flexibility, and growth.

Today, Nativo continues to set benchmarks for cost efficiency and partner satisfaction, while creating lasting value for advertisers and publishers alike.

Assertive Yield is proud to support Nativo in its mission to connect advertisers and publishers with technology that drives both engagement and growth.

Key Takeaways

✅ 20% Reduction rate directly driven by AY Traffic Shaping
✅ 45% QPS Reduction with no revenue loss
✅ 20% Estimated Net Revenue Uplift
✅ Optimized Specific Demand Partners' Needs
✅ Fastest Onboarding to Date: 2–3 weeks 
✅ Real-time Flexibility and Advanced Controls
✅ Minimal Engineering Lifts
